diagram_previews.alt: Grey circular orbit centred at the star O. The planet starts at P0 on the right, and a blue arrow along the orbit shows a 120 degree turn to P1; the UFO is the red point at the midpoint of O P0, with OU and U P0 each labelled 10000. A red arrow runs from the UFO to P1, and the dashed radius O P1 is labelled 20000, with the 120 degree angle marked at O.
